description: List all MCP servers available through this hub, with their status. Call this first to see what is available. Servers marked "hidden" serve their tools only via their own endpoint, but wake_server/sleep_server still manage them.
name: list_servers

description.description: The child's own title, empty if it has never connected.

hidden.description: Present only for a server whose tools are served by its own endpoint alone.

locked.description: Present for a server with locked tools: whether they are locked for you right now.

lockedTools.description: The locked tools, as name patterns; absent when every tool is locked.

name.description: Name to pass to the other tools.

status.description: What the hub is currently doing with this server.

toolCount.description: Tools this server offers through the hub, after its filter.

unlockedUntil.description: When your unlock ends, if you hold one (ISO 8601).

title: List MCP servers
